C0.quote: a set of strategic agents have private preferences over the facility location
C0.note: Facility location aggregates agents' reported ideal points into a collective location. This is a strategyproof voting scheme in the generalised median voter tradition (Kim and Roush; Peters et al. 'voting schemes'), so coded ELIG. The case is borderline.

C5.2.note: Cost is defined on true ideal points. The mechanism is applied to the true profile, which strategyproofness implicitly justifies.
